# Behaving gizmo

`Gizmo: giz-behaving` `LIVE`

## What it does

Holds the behaviours the two records beside it cite. Nothing here is under test: this is the far end of the citations,
so that a `Covers` line naming a behaviour that exists is told from one naming a behaviour that does not.

## Behaviours

### It hums

Continuously, at the pitch the owner set.

### It rattles

Under load, and the rattle is what the humming stops for.

### It purrs

When idle, which is the behaviour nothing is obliged to cover.
